set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-maintenance.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: S5/export is closed. Its deletion mutants do not prove nonzero loss accounting; this recorded FOLLOW-UP remains open and does not reopen the landed export slice.

Remaining / next action: Add a validated export fixture with nonzero feature-spaces/sidecars/feature-refs/sensory-profiles. Assert four exact loss counts and kill each hard-coded-zero mutant while siblings pass.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

FOLLOW-UP (T4) from S5 (bd-01M19XMQN4VK4WSTVSHBD3X1YB, candidate claude-sm/storymodel-export@06d8ebec).

What survives today: the loss records for feature-spaces, sidecars, feature-refs and sensory-profiles are zero in the War of the Ghosts fixture and in the suite's variant model. Deleting a record is killed by name (17/17 mutants). But a miscount (for example hard-coding 0) survives, because every fixture has zero of each.

Acceptance: StoryModelExportSuite builds a validated TextModel carrying at least one of each (a feature space, a sidecar manifest, a feature ref, a sensory profile). Each lossTest then asserts the exact nonzero count, and a count mutant ("dropped = Some(0)") for each of the four fails its named test with the siblings passing.
Scope: pipeline/src/test only; no production change expected.
